'''HN Group''' is the parent company of the Horizon businesses, bringing together [[Horizon Network]] and [[Horizon Media Group]]. [[Horizon Development]] is part of Horizon Network, and [[Horizon Advertising]] is a subsidiary of Horizon Media Group that is managed by Horizon Network.<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/about About HN Group], hngroup.org.uk.</ref> Together the companies cover what a modern business needs online: the infrastructure it runs on, the software it uses, the advertising that brings customers in and the media that tells its story.

The group describes its purpose as "building the digital infrastructure, products and media for tomorrow's businesses".<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/ HN Group home page], hngroup.org.uk.</ref>

== History ==
HN Group was formed by the merger of [[Horizon Network]] and [[Horizon Media Group]], which took effect on 1 September 2026, the day HN Group's parent company was incorporated. Both companies came under HN Group's ownership, keeping their own names, brands and subsidiaries, and all of their staff and staff contracts moved to HN Group.<ref>[https://news.hngroup.org.uk/#article-5e9bd91db3d9ece8a6b701a0 Horizon Network and Horizon Media Group merge to form HN Group], HN Group News.</ref>

== Structure ==
{{Main|List of HN Group companies}}
{{Company ownership|HN Group}}

The group's companies, as recorded on the HN Group Company Register:
{{Company tree}}

=== HN Group Management ===
[[HN Group Management]] owns the group's assets, including its domains, Discord servers and technical assets, and manages all of HN Group's email services. It has no staff of its own and is managed directly by HN Group staff.

=== Horizon Advertising ===
[[Horizon Advertising]] has an unusual arrangement. It is a '''subsidiary of [[Horizon Media Group]]''', but it is '''managed by [[Horizon Network]]''', which runs it day to day alongside its digital infrastructure and [[Horizon Development]]. This is why the group's websites present Horizon Advertising among Horizon Network's services.

{{Company list}}

== How the group works ==
HN Group describes its way of working as "shared people, shared systems, shared standards". Being one group means the companies work as one team, and a client of one Horizon business can draw on the skills of all of them.<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/about About HN Group], hngroup.org.uk.</ref> The group sets out three principles:

; One team across the group
: People work across companies, so the right expertise is always close by. Staff can hold roles at more than one company at the same time.
; Built to keep running
: Services are monitored 24/7, and the systems behind them are built and run in-house.
; Clear and straightforward
: Plain answers, honest reporting and no surprises.

== Areas of work ==
=== Infrastructure ===
Digital services and hosting from [[Horizon Network]], monitored around the clock. Horizon Network is developing Horizon Hosting, offering VPS, dedicated servers and managed cloud.

=== Advertising ===
Display advertising and campaign management from [[Horizon Advertising]], with clear reporting.

=== Software ===
Custom software and web applications from [[Horizon Development]], from first idea to launch.

=== Media ===
Content and media from [[Horizon Media Group]], the group's media arm.

== Brand ==
[[File:hn-group-wordmark.svg|thumb|The HN Group wordmark, with the stepped eight-colour stripe]]
The HN Group wordmark is a heavy logotype set above a stepped line of eight brand colours. Purple is the group's core accent colour, and the typeface used across the group is '''Plus Jakarta Sans'''.

=== Logos ===
HN Group and [[Horizon Network]] use wordmarks: the company name above the stepped colour stripe. [[Horizon Advertising]], [[Horizon Development]], [[Horizon Media Group]] and [[HN Group Management]] use roundels: a thick ring containing the company's initials, shown alongside the company name. Horizon Advertising's roundel is lavender ({{Swatch|#7B52C4}}<code>#7B52C4</code>); the others are indigo ({{Swatch|#5514B4}}<code>#5514B4</code>). Every logo has a white version for dark backgrounds, and the roundel companies also have an app icon.

{| class="wikitable"
! Company !! Logo style !! Colour
|-
| [[HN Group]] || Wordmark with colour stripe || Multicolour
|-
| [[Horizon Network]] || Wordmark with colour stripe (also stacked) || Multicolour
|-
| [[Horizon Advertising]] || Roundel "HA" || Lavender
|-
| [[Horizon Development]] || Roundel "HD" || Indigo
|-
| [[Horizon Media Group]] || Roundel "HM" || Indigo
|-
| [[HN Group Management]] || Roundel || Indigo
|}

Logos are used as supplied: they aren't recoloured, stretched, cropped or redrawn, and the regular version is used on light backgrounds with the white version on dark ones.

== Careers ==
HN Group advertises open roles across all of its companies on the careers page of its website, where anyone can apply with a CV.<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/careers Careers], hngroup.org.uk.</ref> Because people work across the group, a role in one company can lead to opportunities in the others.
